subject: Request: Data subject access & deletion — clarification on routing and timelines
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@acme-retail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: privacy@acme-retail.com
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data subject request — access + deletion for user@example.com

Hello team,

We9ve received a data subject request from one of our customers (user@example.com) asking for both a copy of all personal data you hold and deletion across all systems. Per our contract, Acme Retail is the controller. We need Redwood to confirm:

- Your role (controller vs processor) for our hosted account "acme-prod" and for our Dedicated instance (tenant id: "acme-ded-01").
- The canonical export you will provide for access requests (format and fields).
- Whether deletion includes backups and logs, and what proof you can provide.
- Expected timeline and acknowledgement SLA.

Attached is the filled DSR form from the user for verification. Please confirm receipt and next steps.

Attachments: filled_dsr_form.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Data Protection Officer
Acme Retail
elena.morales@acme-retail.com
+1 415-555-0132

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@acme-retail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data subject request — access + deletion for user@example.com

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the note and attachment — received.

Short answers up front:
- Role: For hosted Redwood API accounts (e.g., acme-prod) Redwood is a data processor. For Dedicated (acme-ded-01) we remain an operator and processor per the Dedicated contract, unless otherwise contractually agreed that Acme assumes full control in a Private deployment. We will include the specific clause references in our follow-up.
- Export format: We can provide a JSON/CSV export that includes account identifiers, user identifiers, token of record, and associated metadata. We will share a sample schema.
- Deletion scope: We delete application-layer customer data on request; backups are handled per our backup retention policy and deletion events propagate to active stores. Deletion from immutable backups may be logical (access revoked) and we can provide a deletion log showing when the primary data was removed.
- SLA: We will acknowledge within 72 hours and target completion within 30 days for standard requests. Complex requests (large volumes, legal holds) may require more time and we9ll notify you.

Next steps for us:
1) Laura (legal) — can you confirm the exact contract terms to quote back to Acme re: role/authority?
2) Priyom (security/ops) — can you prepare the data mapping export for tenant acme-prod and the deletion evidence checklist we can provide?
3) Elena — we9ll open a secure ticket and provide instructions for identity verification.

I9m attaching our internal routing playbook and will follow up with the export schema by EOD.

Attachments: redwood-dsr-routing-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Elena Morales <elena.morales@acme-retail.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data subject request — access + deletion for user@example.com

Hi all,

Confirming what Karthik outlined. A few legal clarifications and asks so Acme can close the loop with the requester:

- Contract reference: see DPA Section 2.1 ("Roles and Responsibilities") which states Redwood acts as processor for Hosted and Dedicated offerings; for Private (on-prem) deployments the customer is controller and operator. I will pull the exact redline and send a snippet to Elena.
- Evidence we can provide: data export file, deletion confirmation statement, deletion event logs (timestamped), list of subprocessors involved in processing for acme-prod, and the retention policy referencing backups. We cannot, however, alter immutable backup chains; instead we provide proof of logical deletion and confirmation of access controls.
- Suggested SLA language for Acme to include in their customer-facing process: acknowledge within 72 hours, substantive response within 10 business days, completion target 30 calendar days unless scope change.

Priyom: please generate the tenant-level data map and a one-page deletion-evidence checklist indicating where Redwood can provide definitive proof vs. where we provide an attestation.

Elena: please confirm the tenant (acme-prod vs acme-ded-01) that applies to this request, and whether the user is tied to a shopper account or an internal employee. Also let us know if Acme requires SCC references or the latest subprocessors list in the response.

I9m attaching a template the Acme team can complete for large-volume requests (helps us triage).

Attachments: data_mapping_request_template.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Privacy
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Hi Elena,

Quick summary and next actions from Redwood:

1) Acknowledgement: Received your request (this thread). Formal acknowledgement ticket created: https://redwood.support/ticket/PRIV-4521
2) Role: Redwood is the processor for acme-prod (hosted) and acme-ded-01 (Dedicated). If Acme is running a Private/on-prem package, role assignments vary per contract — please flag if that is the case.
3) Timeline: We will acknowledge within 72 hours (completed). Target completion: 30 calendar days. If we need an extension, we will notify you with reasons and expected completion date.
4) Deliverables we will provide:
   - Data export (JSON/CSV) for user@example.com with field-level schema.
   - Deletion confirmation statement and deletion event logs (timestamps and internal job ids).
   - Subprocessor list and SCC references on request.

Action items:

- Priyom: prepare the export schema and start the data map for acme-prod. Estimated initial export ready in 3 business days; full deletion evidence packet within 12 business days unless scope expands.
- Laura: please prepare the citation from the DPA to include in our response to Acme.

For identity verification and secure upload, please use the secure link we'll send to privacy@acme-retail.com.

Thanks — we9ll keep this thread updated as items are ready.
